verdict.rationale: Supabase CLI explicitly supports running the entire stack locally via `supabase init` and `supabase start`, with docs confirming it works on a machine or in CI, matching the story precisely. Community feedback corroborates that developers do use this locally but flags migration/local-dev workflow friction as a weak point, a secondary caveat rather than a contradiction of the core capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on report specifically confirming smooth full-stack local emulation (only migration pain points surfaced).
